Rehabilitation is the process of [[ennoblement]] without [[ascension]].

Because we live in a [[Faustian]] culture most people are ascended beyond their ennoblement. As a result most people are mini-onis, with great power but little spiritual integration or centeredness.

The priority as such is to start with rehabilitation after you have agreed to the Lambda Covenant and do it until you have reached Nobility, or the maximum amount of ennoblement you can reach at your level of ascension.<ref name=":0">https://evolution.faith/lambda-covenant/</ref>

People normally see [[ascension]] as a lot more exciting than [[ennoblement]], that’s why [[faustery]] is so tempting. But we leave ascension for the [[Alpha Covenant]] so it can be done safely.

Practice using the [[Sevenfold Vaccine|Ninefold Vaccine]] is key to [[ennoblement]] and [[rehabilitation]]. It will be tailored to the individual so they can best apply it to their life.

[[The Pride|A community]] is key to maintaining and implementing ennobling practices.

Reaching Nobility is not hard. It’s a reasonable expectation that anyone can fulfill. It’s not the grand enlightenment of other traditions, it’s a simple state anyone can achieve with a small amount of effort.<ref name=":0" />
